utterances.text: Mr. Zivanovic, this subordination that you are talking about. Could you give a time-frame for that, for this question?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Would you please tell us when was Jan Marcek subordinated to this officer by the name of Losanovic?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it was all the way up to the time when the Guards Brigade left for Belgrade or immediately before that.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Now --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: And starting when?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Starting when?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well I can't be specific. First the OG South command issued its order appointing command posts and commanders, and then based on their order we, the brigade command, appointed our officers and our people -- or personnel to appropriate villages.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: So if I understood Mr. Zivanovic's question correctly, this is after your order appointing the Ovcara village command. And do I understand it correctly from your previous answers that this order was given somewhere in December?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I think it was in December. Now I can't recall the exact date.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: In your answer to my previous question, you said that the OG South command first issued an order appointing the town and village commanders, and then based on that order you appointed other town and village commanders; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: So the order from the OG South on your appointment preceded your order appointing Jan Marcek as the village commander?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. The OG South did not appoint Marcek directly there, we did, and he was part of the OG South. Yes, yes. In fact, it is a bit unclear but there was some other considerations. He was -- he belonged to me under the establishment and I wanted to deal with it before the Guards Brigade left, and I appointed him so that he would be already in place once the Guards Brigade leaves.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Let me repeat my question because you did not answer it. So I'm saying that before Jan Marcek was appointed by you, you were appointed the town commander by OG South?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. No, no, no. I am not talking about my appointment as the town commander but the appointment of town commands, and I then issued my own order appointing town commands in the Negoslavci, Mitnica, Ovcara -- well, I can't now enumerate all those villages but commands in all those villages.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And on the 19th of November, the way I understand it, you issued this order appointing Marcek the commander of Ovcara?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And what was your function at that time?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Brigade commander.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And your area of responsibility included Ovcara?

utterances.speaker: MILORAD VOJNOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Thank you. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Colonel Vojnovic, this brings your testimony to an end. You are now released as a witness. The Court Usher will escort you out of the courtroom, and we thank you for coming to The Hague to assist us and we wish you a safe journey home.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 3rd day of June, 2013, at 9.00 a.m. 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 12.24 p.m.,
